recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-49803 unless the work group separately decides to change package-level Observation-vitalsigns guide metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-49803 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 after the OO vote on 2025-01-28. It requested the Vital Signs profiles be updated to FMM 4, except the Vital Signs Panel profile, which should be FMM 3.
initial_application: The source application appears in commit e310a0cfa367251d83d375ce0ca75c3286ef3473 and merge commit 67f1afa39d79c7246d74b47c8ac545abd018c4a1 for PR #3327. That change set the eleven Observation Vital Signs StructureDefinition FMM extensions to their current target values.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/list-Observation-packs.xml includes ImplementationGuide/Observation-vitalsigns. That guide references the eleven Vital Signs StructureDefinition profiles checked here. The guide retains package-level FMM 5 metadata, but it is not itself one of the StructureDefinition profiles named by the Jira request; later history touched the guide for status-page metadata without changing the profile-level application. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the build-scope profile sources already match the applied decision: vitalsigns, bmi, bodyheight, bodytemp, bodyweight, bp, headcircum, heartrate, oxygensat, and resprate are FMM 4, and vitalspanel is FMM 3.

related_jiras.note: PR #3327 also adjusted Medical Product of Human Origin profile FMM metadata, but that is a separate BiologicallyDerivedProduct artifact already represented on the combined branch.
